mapper.select: SELECT id, api_code AS apiCode, node_code AS nodeCode, node_type AS nodeType, node_name AS nodeName, node_desc AS nodeDesc, is_active AS isActive, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM biz_tracking_node_dict WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT node_code AS nodeCode, node_type AS nodeType, node_name AS nodeName, MAX(node_desc) AS nodeDesc FROM biz_tracking_node_dict WHERE is_active = 1
AND node_type = #{nodeType}
AND node_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nodeName}, '%')
AND node_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nodeCode}, '%')
GROUP BY node_code, node_type, node_name ORDER BY node_type, node_name, node_code
